_doc: The Atlas Todo app manifest, compiled into the server (atlas-core) and bundled by the clients (packages/client-core); operators never load manifests from disk. `kinds` lists the entity kinds the app syncs, by their real names, which only clients see (sync protocol 7, docs/decisions/0006). `wire` is the kind the server sees instead: `todo.project` for a project, `todo.sealed` for everything else, `project_member` for the server-authored membership rows. Every field travels under an opaque per-entity tag inside an encrypted value, except `public_fields`, which keep their names because the server acts on them: a project's `deleted_at`/`archived_at` are owner-only (values still encrypted), an attachment's `blob_sha`/`thumb_sha` address its blobs. `plaintext_fields` (a subset of `public_fields`, or "all" for server-authored kinds) travel unencrypted. `legacy_plaintext_fields` are the fields protocol 6 sent in plaintext, under the real kind name as the wire kind; such rows stay readable until clients migrate them (POST /sync/legacy/drop). Bump `version` whenever the kinds or their fields change.
name: Atlas Todo
